svg.aria-label: Accuracy by version: v1 73.0 percent on 770 questions, v2 77.1 on 770, v8 81.7 on the 349-question gate split, sdk_v1 90.5 on the same 349; a dashed line marks the 89.4 percent human-expert figure from the ConvFinQA paper, on a different split.
svg.title: From 73.0% to 90.5%: v1, v2, v8, sdk_v1

g.title: v1 · 73.0% (562/770) · the starting prompt set, t1.p1.r1.c1
v2 · 77.1% (594/770) · a GEPA run over DSPy, all four prompts; champion again after the 2026-09-03 rollback and the baseline of campaign c01

v8 · 81.7% (285/349) on the unseen gate split · campaign c01 experiment 3: the teacher blamed the retriever, one prompt changed, +4.58 pp over v2, one-sided clustered McNemar p 0.040 · the champion the demo serves

sdk_v1 · 90.5% (316/349) on the same 349 questions · v8's four prompts distilled into one Claude session on claude-sonnet-5 with the same six calculator tools · +8.88 pp over v8, p 0.0003 · promoted to sdk_champion, never champion

human expert 89.4% · Chen et al. 2022, Table 5, on the paper's held-out test set; the 349-question split here is drawn from the public train pool, so this line is orientation, not a like-for-like baseline
